title: docs(skills): the automation skill no longer says a flow name two packages hold is never armed
body:
Part of #31696

This is the skills part of the card, and it carries one sentence. The card stays open: `flow` joining `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, the other `/automation` doors, the dogfood pins, the epic's Q4 pin and the inbound-hook line of this skill belong to the card's final part, dispatched separately (seat ruling 6794435934; step-0 ruling 6760193376 is unchanged).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-automation` 技能 `subflow` 行末尾的括注，从「an older clash, never armed」改为「each armed」。全 PR 只动这一处技能文本，外加一个 changeset。
- 为什么改：原句说「两个包持有同一个流程名时，两个都不会被武装」。自 #32239 起引擎按（包，名）各自持有并武装，自 #32374 起四种触发器按槽位各自触发，所以这句话在 `main` 上已经是错的，客户的 agent 照着读会以为这两个流程都不运行。
- 风险与回滚：只改一句技能文本，无运行时代码。行数不变（467 → 467），token 少 4（6861 → 6857，天花板 6861 未动）。新句不说这种状态是怎么来的，所以命名空间开关落地前后都成立。回滚即撤回此 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 第 76 行（`subflow` 行）行尾括注，diff 里唯一的技能改动。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main --word-diff -- skills`，预期只见 `[-an older clash, never-]{+each+} armed` 一处；再跑 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期该文件一行为 `6857 tokens (ceiling 6861; headroom 4)`。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触 `skills/**`（Tier H），席位契约复审之后，需要一位授权审批人 Approve；之后由席位落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `subflow` row. The refusal the row teaches is unchanged: a caller that names neither package is refused, naming both holders (`ambiguous-in-closure` for a package caller, `ambiguous-in-environment` for a package-less one). Only the remark about the two flows themselves changes: `(package / package-less caller; an older clash, never armed)` becomes `(package / package-less caller; each armed)`.
- `.changeset/31696-automation-skill-subflow-armed.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, with both declaration lines.

Nothing else in the pack changes. No eval, example or reference file pins the old words: under `skills/` and `content/docs/`, `older clash` appears on this one line only, and the other `never armed` hits (under `content/docs/`) are about a flow with no `start` node, a different state.

## Tests

No package test is owed and no ablation was run: the diff is one sentence of skill text and a changeset, and no tested behaviour changes. The sentence was read against the landed code:

- `AutomationEngine.activateFlowTrigger` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:4020`) arms each slot of a name two packages hold under the slot's key. It still declines one state only, the lone slot left when the other holder's body was refused.
- The landed pin is `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-triggers-per-slot.test.ts` ("each slot of a shared name fires its own body, and its run reads the flow's name in params"). It was read, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope ruling.** The first round of this dispatch stopped with no PR (report 6794360256): the order had this PR complete the card, while the card's own build item (the flow switch) is not on `main`. The seat split the work (6794435934). The inbound-hook line that the first commit on this branch added (775b07f19c) is removed again by bacf69bb89 and moves to the final part, because the file sits at its token ceiling and that line costs 57 tokens. The squashed diff carries the parenthetical only.
- **Wording holds on both sides of the switch.** The old remark "an older clash" is dropped with "never armed". Today two packages come to hold one flow name only through a clash a cold boot seals (install refuses a new one); once `flow` joins the namespace-scoped set, two namespaces may each ship the name. "Each armed" is true in both states, so the switch needs no second edit of this line.
- **The ceiling row is not touched.** `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` keeps the automation row at 6861; the file now measures 6857 (headroom 4). Lowering the row to the measurement is legitimate but that script is outside this PR's file surface, so it is left to the seat.
- **Serial constraint.** One page of open pulls (29) was read; the three whose titles name skills, flows or hooks (#32384, #32391, #32214) do not touch `skills/objectstack-automation/**`.
- **Not measured locally.** `check:doc-formula-expressions` needs `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` built. That build went to the shared verify lock three times and never got a turn (540 s each, behind whole-repo builds), so the reading is CI's. The diff adds no expression and no code fence.
